subject: Remove duplicate unreachable "command" branch in fuzzer arg generator (#4368)
reason: The change deletes a duplicate, unreachable else-if branch in src/fuzzer_command_generator.c, Valkey's in-tree fuzzing harness code. It is dead-code removal in test tooling, not in the server: no command behavior, reply, replication, persistence, or cluster path changes, so no scenario can reach or distinguish it.
